verdict.rationale: Loops documents creating draft campaigns, content included, via its API and Content API/LMX, backed by a public OpenAPI spec and Bearer-token auth. However, its own docs say to "Review and send from the dashboard," so the schedule and send half of the story still requires the dashboard. Missing for 10: API-based scheduling or sending of campaigns/broadcasts, fully dashboard-free campaign delivery, independent hands-on corroboration.
